RISING WATER

Colorado River Basin study area (RiverNets coverage)

Water rises over the study area. Lakes form in the valleys. When two meet, the older one carries on. Each bar runs from the water level where its lake forms to the level where it merges. The lowest lake’s bar never ends. The water on the map and the barcode are computed in your browser from the same 326 × 414 elevation grid; the shaded relief under the water is precomputed.
